POST /api/chat/send with media - creates message with image attachment
All auth protection tests passed (401 for unauthenticated requests)

Home screen - Daily question card with category badge (Future)

Us tab sub-nav - 6 items (Pathways, Trust, Calendar, Lists, Portraits, Astrology)
Me tab sub-nav - 5 items (Favorites, Journal, Stars, Love Language, Profile)

love_language_quiz.details: GET quiz returns 15 questions and 5 languages without auth. POST submit calculates scores correctly. GET results returns saved data with primary/secondary languages.

couple_portraits.details: UI has prompt input, 6 style options (Anime, Watercolor, Oil Painting, Digital Art, Pencil Sketch, Pop Art), Generate button. API endpoints protected and functional.

astrology_deep_dive.details: POST endpoint returns full astrology data including sun/moon/rising signs, element, modality, personality, love style, compatibility score, strengths/challenges, weekly forecast, advice.

push_notifications.details: Subscribe/unsubscribe/status endpoints all functional. Browser Notification API integration present in UI.

partner_sync.details: GET /api/daily-question/partner returns partner_answered status. Both answers revealed only when both partners have answered.

chat_media_attachments.details: Attach button (+) present in chat UI. POST /api/chat/send accepts media_data and media_type parameters.

profile_screen.details: Shows user info, zodiac signs, love language, notification settings toggle, sign out button. Links to Love Language and Astrology screens.

notifications_banner.details: GET /api/notifications returns notifications. Banner shows on home screen when quiz not completed.
